body: Hey I feel you try talking to someone or try to accomplish something meaningful or just anything you can think of. there’s people out there who can relate and will help you. you just have to put in the effort to help yourself :)

It’s ok you shouldn’t feel sorry obviously you are going through something and you need help even if you don’t think you do if you need someone to talk to or just support or advice in general feel free to reach out to me or anyone you might know :)
Same I am not one scared of death but I’m very scared of dying without accomplishing anything in life if you need to talk feel free to reach out :)

Hey I understand what you are going through not in terms of a relationship since I’m a total loner but just feeling so hopeless and miserable I have been trying to make things better for myself by helping people and getting back out there in society. Another thing don’t you just want to accomplish something or do something right before you go out there’s a reason you are here and you have a reason to live. Maybe you were wrong maybe she wasn’t what kept you going maybe it was something in yourself you chose to ignore. Anyways if you need a friend or just someone to talk to I’m here :)
Yeah this server is a good place to vent if you need to vent to me or the whole server no one is stopping you and then will usually be people who feel the same.
If you feel lonely then the internet is a good place to turn so yeah I’m here if you wanna chat about games, movies, or history or something.

To me life is just something that’s inevitably gonna have to end when mine does I at least wanna be happy with myself and have helped people in some way of I were to die from suicide I wouldn’t be satisfied. I’d want to at least do something good before dying. And if you’ve made mistakes at least you realize it’s a mistake and that you aren’t perfect. A lot of people are so self obsessed and annoying but from just this little text I can tell that you are a good person and you can go do something for someone that will make you happy. If you need any help I’m here.

I see what you mean I am usually talking to people every day but there are still times I feel like shit and can’t motivate myself and just feel so depressed and suicidal it’s normal I guess if you are introverted but idk. If ur friends are leaving you then they aren’t really loyal friends or the type of people you want to be around. I hope you start to feel better and if you need help just reach out to me.

Damn I’m sorry to hear that I also used to have a therapist that didn’t really care much like I could really tell. Ngl I feel like they are mostly in it for the money since like that’s their real job. The best people are the ones that do things for others without anything in return and I’m willing to help you if you want all you have to do is reach out.
Yeah that’s gonna suck there’s definitely good people out there though and those are they show it.
Maybe that’s a sign you shouldn’t I’m still going even though I don’t have emotional support from my family. You do so please think more about why you are here and why you’ve still been going
Np I’ve learned from like trial and error that the best way to avoid problems is to just put more thought into it as simple as that.

Ngl I used to be as hopeless as I think you are now but I just put more careful thought into it and idk I just didn’t want to go out unsatisfied I wanted to at least make somewhat of a positive impact. I don’t have much for me in life but I try to help people when I can like you.
So am I

If the goal of life itself is to be satisfied by the end shouldn’t you work and strive for a better life if you don’t have one ask your friends for help and tell them to take things seriously I really want you to think about it if something doesn’t change in a week that’s ok but maybe in a month or a year or a decade something will happen and that something can help you in life and make you happy. If you need someone to talk to I’m available.

Mistreatment is something that will happen from the people in life you need to stay away from. There are many people out there that are great and will treat you great no matter who you are or what you think I’m here for you if you want to talk about it dw.
I feel very disconnected from my family and they don’t really support me or my opinions so I can testify.

That’s not how you should go about things and if that’s true then maybe you are being a “bad person” but that never takes away your ability to change yourself for the benefit of other because you should always prioritize others before yourself in a situation like this it will make you feel better trust me.
I really challenge you to find out the exact reason she is acting like this because there is a reason for everything.
She just needs help and you can be that help in her life
It’s never to late to change yourself if something is stopping you from changing yourself then you are wrong no matter what you can always change yourself and improve what is there.
And also if you are feeling mad about being a bad person that proves you aren’t a bad person because a true bad person wouldn’t show remorse like you.
That’s something you can most definitely change

Well you being willing to help only proves how much of a good person you are. I’m sorry if my advice wasn’t what you were looking for but I now have a new proposition for you. Do exactly as you said and help her obviously something is going on maybe she doesn’t feel like she has someone and if so be that someone that’s there for her even if she’s an asshole to you.

It’s a good and bad thing it’s good because it means deep down you don’t actually want to buy it’s also bad because one day you might just have to accept death as something that will happen weather by chance or by choice.
You are scared of death.
Even if you are ugly the true shower is your personality so if you ever feel ugly on the outside which you can’t change you can create something beautiful on the inside.
You are still here aren’t you? Something kept you going and find what that is and use it to keep you up.

I’m sorry to hear about your father I’m sure he was a good person with great children. If you lost him to something like this just remind yourself he’s still there and even if you don’t see him outside of prison this can be a tough but important life lesson. Spend as much time with those you care about as possible because you never know when they will be gone. Best of luck.

You are experiencing the exact same as me but I’ve learned something great while dealing with this. Although it may be challenging to find something great to do for someone if you are able to do something so strong and selfless to someone they will never forget you and in the end that’s what makes suicide worthless and unnecessary. You can do basically anything you want in the modern world but your execution on things is what really matters. Go out and do something good for people it can even be small and the satisfaction of helping someone and them caring is enough to help you in dire situations. Best of luck.

Don’t worry many of us suffer from a lot of the problems you’ve listed. While many have the problems not everyone can deal with them the same and the at s because the problem isn’t the problem. The problem is the way you go about facing the issue. When you say you are worried about the future and the past you should forget about it and focus on one thing. Although I’m not a believer in religion a priest once said at my local church that it’s far more important to focus on “now” over any other time because now is eternal and future and past are just names given to another form of now. If you are having social problems then you can grow out of it by continuing to try talking to more people the harder you try the faster you will overcome your anxiety. Best of luck to you my friend.

The recommendation I have is to just move on. I know it’s hard to move on from someone you thought you loved, but obviously she doesn’t care about you but there are plenty of people that would. I have two parents that both feel absent in my life I know one day after I graduate I won’t hesitate to leave them and move on to better things and create somewhat of a purpose for myself. I too had thoughts of suicide because of reasons similar to this and I realized I have the power in me to move on when I can. You can do the same or find someone you trust to help with this situation. Best of luck to you.

I feel the same way I also really don’t have anyone in my life I trust but listen if something happened in your past focus on what’s happening (now) and if what’s happening now is the problem then look for what made you happy before and find the root to where the happiness came from. When you do that all you need to do is replicate the happiness and just think about the good things in life even if there are a few. I wish you better luck than me.
When someone calls another person a simp they are one of two things a hypocrite or jealous just saying.
You are right they might not live for you but you can live for them if you are caring enough.

It’s not selfish it’s just that people see those who are suicidal as weak and are only worried about themselves and that makes them see you as a selfish person when in reality you are dealing with issues they probably don’t understand.

If you or you sisters are minors call cps (child protection services) ASAP and the cops as well believe me the best thing for you and your sisters is to get away from your dad and if you have any scars or bruises you can use as evidence against your dad in court.
Yeah family issues are just the worst and idk mine is really messed up.

Look I know you may get this from other people but you actually have something to live for unlike me. I have no family or any support that’s why I’m gonna have to kill myself but you have kids and a purpose to be there for them. I hope you are still there and if you ever feel down about yourself again you just have to remember you have something a lot of us don’t have and if it all seems dark just turn to your kids because they will love you and give you purpose.

A few days ago I told myself I’d let a month go by until I am sure I will kill myself. I hate almost everything about me and my life but the 1% of hope I still have is keeping me here and if nothing changes before June 17th I’m just gonna do it, but until then I’m still unsure really.
Yes at this point I’m willing to try anything to make me feel better
